intro: The Warrior is Guildrun's front-line Attack class: heroes who deal damage with autos and active abilities while scaling Crit, Rush, and Shields. Unlike pure Tanks, Warriors want to hit back — they convert survivability into offense, making them the backbone of durable aggro boards in Demo 0.5.3. Build a Warrior core when the shop keeps offering Attack, Rush, and shield pieces and you need a front line that still threatens kills.
seoDescription: Guildrun Warrior class guide: Attack front-liners scaling Crit, Rush, and Shields. Best Warrior heroes, relics, and how to build a durable comp.
roleLabel: Front-line Attack bruiser — Crit / Rush / Shield scaling
strength: Self-sufficient melee: shields from combat let Warriors trade into the front hex and still output damage
weakness: Needs hits to land — kited, stunned, or out-ranged Warriors give up both damage and shields

howToPlay.draft: Anchor the board with one or two Warriors before greedy back-line carries. A Warrior who is already winning trades is your Rank B priority; do not spread ranks across three fragile picks.
howToPlay.shop: Filter for Warrior banners, Attack, and Shield pieces first. Rush duration matters if your Warriors trigger it every fight. Crit becomes strong once the wall already holds.
howToPlay.positioning: Warriors belong on the dive hex or front-mid where their autos connect. Idle Warriors are dead cards — keep them in melee contact, not tucked in the back.

shopPriorities: Warrior banners (Endurance / Bravery / Mending) for class commitment
Attack and Shield items that feed the damage-into-survivability loop
Rush duration when your Warriors reliably trigger Rush
Crit pieces last — only once the front line is stable

signatureHeroes.name: Logan
signatureHeroes.why: Growth Warrior who scales into long fights and converts durability into damage.

signatureHeroes.name: Kai
signatureHeroes.why: Turns shields and survival into finishing damage behind the Warrior wall.

signatureHeroes.name: Tilly

faq.question: What is the Warrior class in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Warriors are an Attack-based front-line class that deals damage with auto attacks and abilities while scaling Crit, Rush, and Shields. They fight on contact and turn survivability into offense.

faq.question: What are the best Warrior heroes in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Reyna and Logan are the core Warrior front-liners, Kai converts shields into finishing damage, and Tilly flexes into a Warrior/Duelist Attack Speed role.

faq.question: What relics work with Warriors?
faq.answer: Warrior banners (Endurance, Bravery, Mending), Attack and Shield items, and Rush duration pieces if your Warriors trigger Rush. Crit is a secondary payoff once the front holds.

faq.question: How do you build a Warrior comp?
faq.answer: Start with one or two durable Warriors, buy Warrior/Attack/Shield relics, Rank B whichever Warrior is winning trades, and add a finisher only after the front line is stable.

tips: A Warrior board that never applies shields is wasting Shield relics — check your applicators before buying more.
Don't draft three walls and no finisher; Warriors want to convert durability into a kill threat.
